title: method: corrplot
description: Coordinate contract for layers[].method='corrplot' (JarvisPLOT adapter-native). Draws the long table emitted by the `correlation` transform: one cell per variable pair, glyph shape from style.method, size from |rho|, colour from rho. Coordinates are optional because x_index / y_index / rho are the transform's own output columns; state them only to point at a renamed column. style takes R corrplot formals -- see `jplot man corrplot`.
x-jarvis-example:
method: corrplot
style:
  method: circle
  type: upper
  order: hclust

coordinates.description: Required axes for corrplot: (none). Optional: x, y, c.
